deviations.observed_behavior: READ.json and WRITE.json operation documents accept null for optional fields that plan.schema.json types without null (ObjectRef catalog/schema, row_limit, row_offset, filter, srid_policy, spatial parameters) and read it as absent.
The relational IR sends null for absent optional fields (filter without .where(), ObjectRef catalog/schema) and the reader accepts it as absent, although plan.schema.json does not admit null there.
plan::Plan, ReadOperation, WriteOperation and ObjectRef deserialize null as absent in optional fields that plan.schema.json types without null, and serialize absent fields as null.

Query results are limited to 8388608 bytes of compact UTF-8 JSON, before returning any result. The bound is recorded here: capability-attributes-v1 is closed and has no member for it. Hazard: discovery alone cannot reveal the bound. Reentry: adopt a successor attributes contract that declares it.

database.query advertises the catalog JSON and Arrow outputs, but this binding produces only the JSON summary. Hazard: a consumer cannot obtain Arrow from this surface. Reentry: implement an Arrow result path under an explicit versioned selection contract; do not impose a JSON-only restriction on query@1.

requirements.evidence: Artifact capabilities select only the answering surface; the target catalog does not imply availability.
Runtime is conditional in the adopted catalog; this artifact implements it.
Catalog v2 is copied exactly; intentionally absent surfaces remain absent.
Transaction handles are native Rust/Python only, never CLI/runtime.
database.execute is absent from runtime discovery and rejected by admission.
Handles remain process/session native; no serialized handle surface.
Result bound enforced; discovery publication is blocked by the immutable closed attributes-v1. See deviation.
Query summary beyond 8388608 compact JSON bytes fails resource_limit/read/none/never; no result escapes. Transport limits belong to the host.
Discovery contract v2/version 2; wire capability version and selectors remain 1.
Admission compares wire version 1, independently of discovery contract 2.
Destination-only binding: no sender or destination selector. Negotiation is the host transport responsibility.
No ingress, queue, forwarding or acceptance store; negotiation context belongs to the host outside the envelope.
Commit cause preserved independently of unknown effect; runtime tests execute defect, IO and timeout vectors.
Withdrawn identifiers; no new JSON-only restriction is introduced.
Load validators and their exact-value dependency from the pinned checkout; keep diagnostics data-free. Upstream fuzz cache is tooling, not a component contract.
Existing JSON summary only; Arrow output gap is declared in deviations and next to the implementation.
